coverage.main: Read all twenty-one pages of arXiv 1906.03499 (AAAI 2020 content): method, experiments (Tables 1-3, Figures 1-5), references and appended material. The AAAI version of record was not retrieved.
coverage.supplement: Any appended material in the arXiv PDF was read; no separate supplement was retrieved.
coverage.excluded_results: All results evaluate adversarial-example detectors (TPR at fixed FPR, AUC). The 'transferability' experiments (Table 3, Figure 5) train detectors on C&W examples and test them on examples from other attack algorithms (L-infinity PGD, FGSM, JSMA, Boundary, DeepFool) against the same classifier. This is detector transfer across attack types, not transfer of adversarial examples across models.

f1.evidence: Detection metrics only; no transferred misclassification rate.

f5.evidence: Attack budgets define detector test sets, not transfer evaluations.

limitations: Retained in the frozen corpus with non-applicability reasons; 'transferability' in this paper refers to detector generalisation across attack types.
